Subject: INVITATION: Norway re-opens the UN Security Council Chamber on April 16th
Importance: High



Dear colleagues,



Please note you are all invited and are welcome to bring your spouse or guest to the April 1601 Norwegian
reopening of the Security Council Chamber (invite below).



If you will attend and bring a guest, please RSVP by no later than 2pm tomorrow, April 111°. Please
provide your guest's full name and affiliation (if applicable).



If you DON'T HAVE A UN pass, the entrance and security screening will be on the 42"1 Street
entrance on I" Avenue directly across from the Tudor City stairs. YOU MUST BRING
IDENTIFICATION! If you have an NGO UN pass, you must still enter as a non-UN pass holder.
